outcome: Incidence of Post-Operative Nausea and Vomiting (PONV)
cohort: The study included 60 parturients who were pregnant women undergoing elective caesarean sections.
finding: Pre-treatment with 0.2 mg of glycopyrrolate before spinal anaesthesia in pregnant women undergoing elective caesarean sections decreases the incidence of hypotension and bradycardia, and reduces the requirement of vasopressors, without serious adverse side effects.
